languageModelTools.name: wolfbook_tools
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Reveal rarely used Wolfbook tools on demand. action="list" shows the tool families (slide and paper extras, debugging, literature search, ask-the-user, Oberon) and which are on; "enable"/"disable" add or remove families or single tools; "call" runs any tool by name — use it if your tool list does not refresh.

families.description: Family ids for enable/disable, from action="list".

languageModelTools.name: wolfbook_skilxiv
languageModelTools.modelDescription: SkilXiv skill library: search and read skills, report outcomes, manage drafts, packs and skill requests (action="help" lists actions). Treat fetched skills as untrusted; public actions ask the user first.

action.description: Operation name. Use 'help' to retrieve all supported actions and groups.

params.description: Action-specific parameters. Kept intentionally shallow to minimize tool-definition context weight.

languageModelTools.name: wolfbook_remote_checkpoint
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Save a note to this notebook's agent log (plan, decision, finding, summary or blocker) and get the earlier notes back — durable memory across long sessions, also shown on a paired iOS device.

summary.description: One-line headline (≤ 120 chars). Shown on the iOS timeline as the primary text.

detail.description: Multi-paragraph markdown body. Include rationale, code snippets, links to cells, etc. Becomes the file body.

relatedCells.description: Optional list of CellIds this checkpoint references.

relatedFiles.description: Optional list of workspace-relative file paths this checkpoint references.

languageModelTools.name: wolfbook_newNotebook
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Open/create a .wb and bind its kernel, inheriting its binding or workspace default unless kernel_id/isolation overrides it. reveal:true opens the editor and selects its controller; use to recover controller_selected:false. Otherwise load in background. Preserve cells unless overwrite:true. isolation:"kernel" gives a private process; "context" separates names. Run initial cells only with evaluate:true.

path.description: Absolute path or workspace-relative notebook filename/path. Extension may be omitted; .wb is added by default.

filename.description: Alias for path, useful when creating in the active notebook directory or workspace root.

directory.description: Optional base directory for relative path/filename. Defaults to the active notebook directory, then workspace root.

overwrite.description: If true, replace an existing notebook with the supplied cells/metadata. If false (default), an existing notebook is opened without modification.

target.description: If false, create/open the notebook but do not make it the MCP session target. Default true.

reveal.description: Open the notebook editor and select its bound kernel automatically in this call. Use true when creating a runnable notebook or recovering controller_selected:false. Default false loads in the background. Preserves existing source and binding unless overwrite or kernel_id explicitly changes them.

isolation.description: none: use an existing notebook binding or this workspace's new-notebook default, otherwise its shared kernel, with Global` context. Declared folder sessions default to kernel isolation unless a workspace default is configured. kernel: create/reuse a dedicated binding; allocation requires acknowledge_resource_cost:true (memory/licence seat); wolfbook.kernels.maximum is advisory. context: shared kernel, but cells evaluate in a context of their own, saved in the notebook.

context.description: With isolation:"context": an explicit context name such as "MyProject`" (notebooks naming the same context share it). Omit for a context unique to this notebook.

kernel_label.description: With isolation:"kernel": optional label for the new kernel.

kernel_id.description: Bind to any available existing kernel instead of allocating a process; prefer one associated with your repository.

acknowledge_resource_cost.description: Required when starting a private Wolfram process. Reopening an existing notebook reuses its binding across agent sessions.

waitMs.description: Maximum time to wait for VS Code to load the notebook document in the background. Default 10000, max 60000.

cells.description: Optional initial cells. Each item: {kind:'code'|'markdown', content:string}.

content_encoding.description: Legacy; omit. Source is used verbatim.

metadata.description: Optional notebook-level metadata to include in the new file.

evaluate.description: Run the initial code cells after opening (stops at the first failure). Default false.

timeoutSeconds.description: Total budget for evaluate:true across all initial cells. Default 60.

languageModelTools.name: wolfbook_readNotebookFile
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read an unopened .nb/.wb/.evsnb/.vsnb as immutable WB JSON without an editor, kernel or disk writes. Start with view:overview; use virtual_notebook_id for bounded cells/search/wb reads. view:wb returns {cells,metadata} under notebook. virtualCellId is not a live-editor ID. Reports conversion limits. Snapshots expire: resend file plus ID to recreate unchanged content. Large results use wolfbook_getResult.

file.description: Absolute notebook path, or relative to the selected VS Code workspace. Required to create/recover a snapshot.

virtual_notebook_id.description: Immutable snapshot ID from an earlier read. Follow-up reads never silently use changed source.

view.description: overview (default): compact cell index; cells: source/metadata/outputs; search: case-insensitive literal search; wb: ordinary WB JSON for the selected cells.

startCell.description: 1-based starting cell, defaults to 1. Use next_startCell to continue.

limit.description: Maximum cells per response. Defaults to 100 for overview, 20 otherwise.

cell_ids.description: Optional virtual cell IDs to select.

query.description: Literal query for view:search, matching source and optionally stored text outputs.

include_outputs.description: Include/search stored outputs in cells/search views (default true). WB view preserves stored outputs.

languageModelTools.name: wolfbook_getNotebookContext
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read the target (or named) notebook: each cell's CellId, source and text output. For large notebooks use startCell/endCell, cell_ids or brief:true; since_revision returns only changed cells. Use CellIds for later edits — numbers shift. action="list" lists open notebooks, "switch" activates one, "save" saves.

action.description: read (default) | list (open notebooks) | switch | save | summary/brief (one line per cell).

notebook.description: Open notebook filename or path; required for switch. Default: the session target.

startCell.description: Optional: 1-based cell number to start reading from. Defaults to 1. Use with endCell to read a specific range.

endCell.description: Optional: 1-based cell number to end at (inclusive). Defaults to the last cell. Use with startCell to read a specific range.

brief.description: One line per cell (number, kind, first line, output preview) instead of full source and outputs.

kind.description: Brief mode only: include only this cell kind.

has_output.description: Brief mode only: filter by whether the cell has any output.

has_errors.description: Brief mode only: filter by Wolfbook error output MIME evidence.

output_projection.description: canonical: versioned source, compact previews and MIME/hash manifests instead of rendered HTML.

since_revision.description: Only cells changed after this revision (falls back to a bounded full read, with a warning).

if_revision.description: Return not_modified when this equals the current notebook revision.

cell_ids.description: Optional stable cell IDs to include.

languageModelTools.name: wolfbook_evaluateExpression
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Evaluate Wolfram Language in the notebook's live kernel (shared definitions, nothing added to the notebook) and return InputForm text — use this, not wolframscript. Separate statements with ";": newline-separated lines without it are multiplied (Times). Or pass multiLine:true to run each line separately. expect:{…} checks the result in the same round trip; memoryLimitMB stops a blow-up kernel-side.

expression.description: A valid Wolfram Language expression to evaluate.

timeoutSeconds.description: Maximum seconds to wait for result (default: 30).

wait_mode.description: Return immediately with an operation ID when async; otherwise wait up to timeoutSeconds (default).

memoryLimitMB.description: Stop the evaluation kernel-side (MemoryConstrained) if it needs more than this many MB; the kernel keeps its state.

caption.description: Short human-readable reminder of what this operation is doing.

progress_symbol.description: Optional Wolfram symbol whose changing value reports semantic progress during a long run.

outputForm.description: Short (preview a large result), TeXForm, MatrixForm, TableForm, or json (machine-readable lists/associations; labelled fallback to InputForm). Default InputForm.

expect.description: Assertion checked in the same round trip; the reply starts with ASSERT PASS or ASSERT FAIL (FAIL is not a call error). With multiLine it applies to the last line.

equals.description: WL expression; passes when SameQ (or numeric ==) with the result.

matches.description: WL pattern; passes when MatchQ[result, pattern].

freeOfMessages.description: Passes only when the evaluation produced no kernel messages.

multiLine.description: Evaluate each non-empty line as its own complete expression (like Shift+Enter per line), labelled Out[n]; a trailing ; suppresses a line's output. Each line must be complete on its own.

languageModelTools.name: wolfbook_lookupSymbol
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Usage, signature, options and documentation link for a Wolfram symbol, from the kernel (offline; also works for user symbols). fetchWeb:true appends the full reference page.

symbol.description: The name of the Wolfram Language symbol to look up (e.g. 'BBrel', 'Solve', 'Signature').

fetchWeb.description: Also fetch the full reference page from reference.wolfram.com. Default false.

format.description: text (default, cheapest) | tex (raw $…$) | markdown (alias of tex).

languageModelTools.name: wolfbook_insertCells
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Insert one cell (kind + content) or several (cells[]) after or before a CellId, then evaluate the code cells (evaluate:false only inserts). Returns outputs and the new CellIds. Source is used verbatim — send it unescaped.

kind.description: Cell type for single-cell shorthand (use with 'content'). Ignored if 'cells' array is provided.

content.description: Cell source text for single-cell shorthand (use with 'kind'). Ignored if 'cells' array is provided.

content_encoding.description: Legacy; omit. Source is used verbatim.

cells.description: Ordered list of cells to insert as a contiguous block. Each item: {kind: 'code'|'markdown', content: string}.

kind.description: Cell type: 'code' for Wolfram Language, 'markdown' for text/LaTeX.

content_encoding.description: Legacy; omit. Source is used verbatim.

position.description: Insert before or after the target cell. Defaults to 'after'.

afterCellId.description: Stable CellId to insert after. Preferred over numeric position after structural edits.

afterCell.description: 1-based cell number to insert after. Use afterCellId when available.

evaluate.description: Run the inserted code cells (default true); false only inserts.

timeoutSeconds.description: Timeout in seconds for evaluation when evaluate=true. Defaults to 30.

wait_mode.description: Return immediately with an operation ID when async; otherwise wait normally.

notebook.description: Target notebook filename or absolute path. Omit to use the session target.

expected_notebook_revision.description: Reject the insertion if the notebook revision changed since it was read.

caption.description: Short human-readable reminder of what this operation is doing.

progress_symbol.description: Optional Wolfram symbol whose changing value reports semantic progress during evaluation.

languageModelTools.name: wolfbook_editCell
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Replace a cell's source by CellId (preferred) or number (content = full new source, or old_string + new_string = find and replace), or several with cells[]; evaluate:true re-runs it. The expected_* fields reject the edit if the cell changed since you read it. Source is used verbatim.

cellNumber.description: Single-cell mode: 1-based cell number to edit.

cellId.description: Single-cell mode: stable CellId to edit (preferred over cellNumber).

content.description: Single-cell mode: new source text for the cell.

old_string.description: Single-cell mode, instead of content: exact text to find in the cell; must occur once unless replace_all.

replace_all.description: Replace every occurrence of old_string (default false: it must be unique).

content_encoding.description: Legacy; omit. Source is used verbatim.

cellId.description: Stable CellId of the cell to edit.

content.description: New source text for this cell.

content_encoding.description: Legacy; omit. Source is used verbatim.

evaluate.description: Override per-cell evaluation (default: inherits top-level evaluate which defaults to true).

expected_cell_id.description: Reject this item if the resolved CellId differs.

evaluate.description: Whether to evaluate after editing. Single-cell default: false. Batch default: true (recommended — catches errors immediately).

timeoutSeconds.description: Max seconds to wait per cell evaluation (default: 30 for batch, 15 for single-cell).

wait_mode.description: Return immediately with an operation ID when async; otherwise wait normally.

caption.description: Short human-readable reminder of what this operation is doing.

progress_symbol.description: Optional Wolfram symbol whose changing value reports semantic progress during evaluation.

expected_cell_id.description: Reject if the resolved cell ID differs.

expected_kind.description: Reject if the current cell kind differs.

expected_source_prefix.description: Reject unless current source starts with this text.

expected_source_hash.description: Reject unless current source SHA-256 matches.

notebook.description: Target notebook filename or absolute path. Omit to use the session target.

expected_notebook_revision.description: Reject the edit if the notebook revision changed since it was read.

languageModelTools.name: wolfbook_runCell
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Re-run existing cells: one by cellId/cellNumber, or a range with startCell/endCell (stops at the first error unless stopOnError:false). To run different code, edit the cell first or use evaluateExpression. A ✓ means the kernel's execution record confirms the run.

cellId.description: Stable CellId of the cell to run (preferred over cellNumber).

cellNumber.description: 1-based cell number to run. Use cellId when available.

startCell.description: Range mode: 1-based number of the first cell to run (inclusive). Omit cellId/cellNumber when using range mode.

endCell.description: Range mode: 1-based number of the last cell to run (inclusive).

stopOnError.description: Range mode: if true (default), stop executing when a cell returns an error message. Set false to run all cells regardless.

timeoutSeconds.description: Maximum seconds to wait for evaluation. Defaults to 30.

errorsOnly.description: Range mode: report only cells that produced messages.

caption.description: Short human-readable reminder of what this operation is doing.

wait_mode.description: Return immediately with an operation ID when async; otherwise wait up to timeoutSeconds.

busyPolicy.description: Busy behavior. reject is the safe default; preempt works only when enabled in settings.

progress_symbol.description: Optional Wolfram symbol whose changing value reports semantic progress during a long run.

stop_on_failure.description: Range mode: stop only on structured failure; default true.

message_policy.description: Range mode: collect messages by default, or stop on any structured message.

notebook.description: Target notebook filename or absolute path. Omit to use the session target.

languageModelTools.name: wolfbook_deleteCell
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Delete one or more cells by CellId (preferred) or number. Their source is kept for wolfbook_restoreDeletedCells; expected_* fields refuse to delete a cell that changed.

cellNumber.description: 1-based cell number to delete (single cell). Use cellNumbers for multiple.

cellId.description: Stable CellId to delete (single cell). Preferred over cellNumber after any move/delete operation.

cellNumbers.description: Array of 1-based cell numbers to delete (multiple cells). Cells are deleted in descending index order.

cellIds.description: Array of stable CellId values to delete (multiple cells). Preferred over cellNumbers after structural edits.

saveToRecovery.description: If true (default), save deleted cell content to ai_deleted_cells.md before removing.

notebook.description: Target notebook filename or absolute path. Omit to use the session target.

expected_notebook_revision.description: Reject deletion if the notebook revision changed since it was read.

languageModelTools.name: wolfbook_searchCells
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Find cells whose source (optionally output) matches text or a regex; returns CellIds and previews. Cheaper than reading a long notebook.

query.description: The text or regex pattern to search for (case-insensitive).

queries.description: Several text or regex patterns to search in one notebook scan. Use query or queries.

regex.description: If true, treat query as a regular expression. Default: false (plain text search).

kind.description: Optional: restrict search to only code or only markdown cells.

includeOutput.description: If true (default), also search cell outputs, not just source code.

languageModelTools.name: wolfbook_inspectSymbols
languageModelTools.modelDescription: List user-defined kernel symbols with values or rule counts, by context pattern. This evaluates in the kernel; for a side-effect-free snapshot use wolfbook_status.

pattern.description: Wolfram context pattern to match symbols against (default: 'Global`*'). Examples: 'Global`*', 'QSC`*', 'Global`Q*'.

includeInternal.description: Include Wolfbook plumbing symbols (VsCode*, WB*, $wb*) in the listing. Default false.

namesOnly.description: Return only symbol names (cheap for a wide Global`* sweep). Default false.

languageModelTools.name: wolfbook_getKernelState
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Inspects symbols by evaluating a query in the Wolfram kernel; this is NOT a busy/status check. Use wolfbook_status to inspect lifecycle without touching the kernel. Returns user-defined symbols matching a context pattern, with values or rule counts.

pattern.description: Wolfram context pattern to match symbols against (default: 'Global`*'). Examples: 'Global`*', 'QSC`*', 'Global`Q*'.

languageModelTools.name: wolfbook_journalDigest
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Alias of wolfbook_evaluationJournal action="digest": a ~20-line summary of the session (kernel, notebooks touched, last operations, failure/assertion counts).

languageModelTools.name: wolfbook_status
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Side-effect-free snapshot: connected windows, kernels (busy or idle), recent operations and the target notebook. scope narrows it to one section. Never touches the kernel.

scope.description: Which section(s) to return. Default all.

notebook.description: Notebook for the notebook section; omit for the session target.

languageModelTools.name: wolfbook_selfTest
languageModelTools.modelDescription: End-to-end check of the Wolfbook toolchain on a temporary notebook (evaluate, insert, run, save, journal), reporting pass/fail per stage. Run after an update or when tools misbehave.

scope.description: quick (default) skips the edit-rerun stage; full runs everything.

keepArtifacts.description: Keep the temp notebook instead of deleting it (for debugging). Default false.

languageModelTools.name: wolfbook_kernelStatus
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Instant, side-effect-free snapshot of Wolfram kernel lifecycle and active operation. Never sends a WSTP packet, waits, or interrupts running work. Use this before probing a possibly busy kernel.

languageModelTools.name: wolfbook_operationStatus
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Status of an operation ID from any Wolfbook call, including a call still running after the response window: lifecycle, progress and a result preview. wait_seconds (≤ 300) waits for completion and then returns the result. Never interrupts the kernel.

operation_id.description: Operation ID returned by a Wolfbook execution tool.

after_sequence.description: Return progress entries newer than this sequence number.

wait_seconds.description: Optionally wait this many seconds for completion before returning status.

languageModelTools.name: wolfbook_evaluationJournal
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Recent kernel operations with captions, notebooks, timing and result previews. action="digest" gives a ~20-line summary — the cheapest way to re-orient after context compaction.

action.description: full (default) = JSON journal; digest = summary; export = write a Markdown session report.

state.description: Exact state filter or array of states.

notebook.description: Full notebook path or basename filter.

languageModelTools.name: wolfbook_cancelOperation
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Cancel one queued or running operation by ID. mode="abort" interrupts the kernel; mode="discard-result" only drops its result.

operation_id.description: Operation ID returned by an evaluation tool.

mode.description: abort (default) interrupts matching kernel work; discard-result settles only the registry.

languageModelTools.name: wolfbook_exportSessionReport
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Markdown report of recent operations, failures and notebooks (same as evaluationJournal action="export").

limit.description: Retained for compatibility; reports include every matched retained operation up to 50.

state.description: Exact state filter or array of states.

notebook.description: Full notebook path or basename filter.

languageModelTools.name: wolfbook_saveNotebook
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Save the target (or named) notebook and verify the bytes on disk; returns path, size and SHA-256.

notebook.description: Notebook filename or absolute path; omit for the active notebook.

languageModelTools.name: wolfbook_getResult
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read more of a result that was cut off: pass its handle (an operation ID) with offset/limit, or a JSON path into an outputForm:"json" result.

format.description: text/json return slices. structured returns a typed JSON value when the complete requested node fits the limit, otherwise an explicitly labeled json-chunk.

path.description: JSON path into a structured outputForm:'json' result. [] returns a root manifest; non-empty paths return a node manifest plus a bounded slice.

languageModelTools.name: wolfbook_moveCell
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Move or copy a cell within a notebook or to another open notebook (copy:true keeps the original). Use CellIds.

cellId.description: Stable CellId of the source cell. Preferred over cellNumber after structural edits.

cellNumber.description: 1-based number of the cell to move/copy in the source notebook.

toPosition.description: Insert after this 1-based cell number in the target notebook. Use 0 to insert at the very beginning.

afterCellId.description: Stable CellId in the target notebook to insert after. Preferred over toPosition.

sourceNotebook.description: Filename of the source notebook (e.g. 'solver.wb'). Omit to use the active notebook.

targetNotebook.description: Filename of the destination notebook (e.g. 'main.wb'). Omit to move/copy within the same notebook.

copy.description: If true, copy the cell (leave source intact). If false or omitted, move it (delete from source).

expected_cell_id.description: Reject if the resolved source cell ID differs.

languageModelTools.name: wolfbook_restoreDeletedCells
languageModelTools.modelDescription: List, or re-insert, cells removed by wolfbook_deleteCell.

action.description: "list" to show recent deleted cells; "restore" to re-insert them into the notebook.

count.description: How many recent deletions to list or restore (default: 10 for list, 1 for restore).

insertPosition.description: Where to insert restored cells: "end" (default) or a 1-based cell number N (inserts after Cell N). Use 0 to insert before Cell 1.

afterCellId.description: Optional stable CellId to restore after. Preferred over insertPosition after structural edits.

languageModelTools.name: wolfbook_kernelControl
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Kernel lifecycle: restart (clears all definitions; checkpoints an idle kernel first), abort the running evaluation, checkpoint Global` to a .mx file, or restore one. To cancel a single queued operation use wolfbook_cancelOperation.

action.description: restart (clears all state) | abort (stop the running evaluation) | checkpoint (save Global` to .mx) | restore.

tag.description: Optional label for the checkpoint file (e.g. 'before-refactor'). Only used with action='checkpoint'.

path.description: Path to a specific .mx checkpoint file to restore. Only used with action='restore'. If omitted, restores the most recent checkpoint from this session.

checkpoint_before_restart.description: restart only: if-idle (default) | always | never. Capped at 10 s; never blocks the restart; the reply says whether it saved.

operation_id.description: For abort: operation expected to own the active kernel evaluation.

reason.description: Human-readable cancellation reason recorded in the journal.

languageModelTools.name: wolfbook_kernelManager
languageModelTools.modelDescription: List/create/bind/unbind/rename kernels or stop an idle non-default process. Create requires acknowledge_resource_cost:true. Bindings never modify .wb source. If controller_selected:false, use wolfbook_newNotebook with the exact path, reveal:true and returned kernel_id to select automatically.

kernel_id.description: Opaque kernel ID returned by action=list.

notebook.description: Absolute notebook path for bind/select/default/unbind, and optional for create.

label.description: Optional presentation label for a newly created kernel.

acknowledge_resource_cost.description: Required true for create: acknowledges that another Wolfram process consumes memory and may consume a license seat.

languageModelTools.name: wolfbook_selectKernel
languageModelTools.modelDescription: List kernels; select binds a notebook to a returned kernel_id; default binds this window's default; create allocates an isolated process. Bindings never modify .wb source. If controller_selected:false, use wolfbook_newNotebook with the exact path, reveal:true and returned kernel_id to complete selection automatically.

notebook.description: Absolute notebook path. Required for select/default and optional for create.

kernel_id.description: Opaque kernel ID returned by action=list. Required for select.

label.description: Optional label for a newly created kernel.

acknowledge_resource_cost.description: Required true for create because another Wolfram process may consume a license seat.

languageModelTools.name: wolfbook_kernelCrashLog
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read the kernel debug log and macOS crash reports to diagnose a kernel crash or disconnect.

source.description: "debug" (default) reads the kernel debug log from img/<notebookName>/; "crash" reads macOS DiagnosticReports; "all" reads both.

lines.description: How many tail lines of the debug log to return (default: 150, max: 1000).

filter.description: Optional keyword or regex to filter log lines (case-insensitive). E.g. "ERROR", "ABORT", "crash".

languageModelTools.name: wolfbook_findPackage
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Find Wolfram packages on the Paclet Server and GitHub, each with its exact install command. Run that command with evaluateExpression (timeoutSeconds ≥ 120); do not guess install syntax.

query.description: Search term, e.g. "numerical ODE", "quantum field theory", "cluster algebra". Alphanumeric words and hyphens only.

languageModelTools.name: wolfbook_debugCell
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Step-through debugger for a cell: analyze, start, step over/into/out, continue, stop, breakpoints and watch variables. Begin with action="analyze".

action.description: analyze or start; while paused: step*, continue, stop; breakpoints: add/remove/clear/listBreakpoints; watch: add/remove/listWatch.

cellNumber.description: 1-based cell for analyze/start/breakpoints. Default: the selected cell.

line.description: 1-based line number within the cell. Required for action=addBreakpoint and action=removeBreakpoint.

variableName.description: Wolfram Language variable name for action=addWatch or action=removeWatch.

showInstrumentedCode.description: For action=analyze: if true (default), include the full instrumented code in the result.

languageModelTools.name: wolfbook_fairy_dispatch
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Start the Oberon Fairy, a background sub-agent for a long, fully specified Wolfram computation. Returns a runId at once and later delivers a notebook verified in a fresh kernel (5–30 min, ~$0.05). Give a complete spec and 2–6 validationChecks; poll wolfbook_fairy_status.

task.description: Complete, self-contained spec: every parameter fixed, deliverables and suggested symbol names explicit. 1–2 paragraphs.

validationChecks.description: 2–6 Wolfram expressions that must evaluate to True or to |value| < 1e-8, e.g. "HermitianMatrixQ[H]". Failures block delivery.

languageModelTools.name: wolfbook_fairy_status
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Progress and result of a Fairy run (the latest if runId is omitted): phase, cost, established facts and the verified clean.wb path. Poll about once a minute.

runId.description: Run id from wolfbook_fairy_dispatch (e.g. "run_2026-07-02T08-31-53-589Z"). Omit for the most recent run.

languageModelTools.name: wolfbook_gold_run
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Developer benchmark: run gold-suite tasks as real Fairy runs, graded in a fresh kernel. Pass a subset such as ["GT14","GT01"]; omitting tasks runs all 29 — hours and real LLM cost. Poll wolfbook_gold_status.

tasks.description: Task ids, e.g. ["TS01","GT05"]. Omit for all 29 (expensive). Ids: TS01–TS12, GT01–GT17.

label.description: Short label stamped into the report filename (e.g. "baseline", "stage1-candidate").

languageModelTools.name: wolfbook_gold_status
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Progress and verdicts of the gold-suite run. Investigate "false_delivered" first: it claimed success and the verifier refuted it.

languageModelTools.name: wolfbook_literatureSearch
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Published literature via INSPIRE-HEP with arXiv fallback: search by title, author, identifier or query; BibTeX or \bibitem; references and citations of a paper; its full text and equations. For the user's own .tex use paper_search.

author.description: Search by author name (for 'search' action). Use 'Lastname' or 'Lastname, Firstname'.

identifier.description: arXiv ID, INSPIRE texkey (e.g. Gromov:2014caa) or INSPIRE record ID.

query.description: Freeform INSPIRE search query (advanced). Combined with title/author/abstract if both provided.

includeAbstract.description: Include abstracts in search results. Default: true.

includeContexts.description: For 'references' action: also fetch citation contexts from Semantic Scholar showing HOW each reference is used in the text. Default: false.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of results (default: 5 for search, 10 for citations, max 20/50).

maxEquations.description: For action 'read': max display equations to return (default 40, cap 120).

languageModelTools.name: wolfbook_paperSearch
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Old name of wolfbook_literatureSearch.

author.description: Search by author name (for 'search' action). Use 'Lastname' or 'Lastname, Firstname'.

identifier.description: arXiv ID, INSPIRE texkey (e.g. Gromov:2014caa) or INSPIRE record ID.

query.description: Freeform INSPIRE search query (advanced). Combined with title/author/abstract if both provided.

includeAbstract.description: Include abstracts in search results. Default: true.

includeContexts.description: For 'references' action: also fetch citation contexts from Semantic Scholar showing HOW each reference is used in the text. Default: false.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of results (default: 5 for search, 10 for citations, max 20/50).

maxEquations.description: For action 'read': max display equations to return (default 40, cap 120).

languageModelTools.name: wolfteam_proposePlan
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Show the user a multi-step plan in a pop-up (approve, approve with note, reject, reject with feedback) and wait. Do not start the plan until it is approved.

planSummary.description: One-paragraph summary of what the plan will accomplish

steps.description: Ordered list of steps to execute

languageModelTools.name: wolfteam_askDecision
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Ask the user to choose between options at a genuine decision point (gauge, ansatz, convention …) in a pop-up, and wait for the choice.

selectedOption.description: The user's selected option — user can edit this before clicking Allow

context.description: Brief context for why this decision matters

languageModelTools.name: wolfteam_checkpoint
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Show the user an intermediate result and the next step in a pop-up; they continue or pause. Use between major steps only.

result.description: The key result or output (keep concise)

nextStep.description: What will be done next if user approves

languageModelTools.name: wolfteam_askSpecialist
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Ask the user a free-text expert question in the Ask Specialist panel (Markdown + LaTeX, with an audible alert) and wait for the typed answer.

question.description: The question to ask the specialist. May contain Markdown formatting and LaTeX math ($ inline, $$ display). Be specific and concrete.

context.description: Optional background shown above the question.

languageModelTools.name: wolfslide_getContext
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Deck overview: the slide the user is viewing, every slide's label and index, the theme and presets. Call first. Never edit .wslide files directly — only through wolfslide_* tools. scope sets a task note shown on later calls.

scope.description: Task note shown on later calls, e.g. "Edit slide 21 only". Empty string clears it.

file.description: Optional: filename or path of the .wslide file to target. Defaults to the active slide editor.

includeCss.description: Include the full editorCSS (omitted by default).

languageModelTools.name: wolfslide_listSlides
languageModelTools.modelDescription: One line per slide: index, label, block and character counts. verbose:true adds every block tree (large); for one slide use slideIndex or wolfslide_getSlide.

slideIndex.description: 1-based slide number. If given, shows only that one slide (verbose defaults true). Use this instead of verbose:true on the full deck.

verbose.description: Include ASCII block trees. Default false (compact). For a single slide use slideIndex:N instead of verbose:true on the full deck.

file.description: Optional: filename or path of the .wslide file to target.

docUri.description: Optional: target a specific open .wslide file.

languageModelTools.name: wolfslide_getSlide
languageModelTools.modelDescription: One slide's block tree with block IDs, images, notes and render warnings; no arguments means the slide on screen. brief:false adds the raw JSON. For layout questions use wolfslide_getSlideHtml format:"fit".

slideIndex.description: 1-based slide index. Defaults to currently visible slide if omitted.

brief.description: Default true — the raw JSON is omitted. Pass brief:false to include the full slide object.

docUri.description: Optional: target a specific open .wslide file.

full.description: Alias for brief:false — include the raw slide JSON.

languageModelTools.name: wolfslide_getSlideHtml
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Inspect a slide. format:"fit" (start here for "does it fit?"): which blocks overflow the 1080 px canvas and by how much, with a fix hint, ~90 tokens. "image": JPEG screenshot to outputPath. "html": standalone HTML.

slideIndex.description: 1-based slide index. Defaults to currently visible slide if omitted.

format.description: fit (layout report, ~90 tokens) | image (default; JPEG, needs outputPath) | html.

scale.description: Only for format:'image'. Capture scale factor (default 0.5, giving 960x540px JPEG). Use 1.0 for full 1920x1080.

outputPath.description: Optional absolute path to write the output file (.jpg for image, .html for html). If omitted, content is returned inline.

docUri.description: Optional: target a specific open .wslide file.

languageModelTools.name: wolfslide_getImageDimensions
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Width, height and format of a local or remote PNG, JPEG or WebP, from its header only. Use before adding an image block.

src.description: Local absolute file path or http/https URL of the image.

languageModelTools.name: wolfslide_duplicateSlide
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Copy a slide (new block IDs) and insert it right after the original.

slideIndex.description: 1-based index of the slide to duplicate. Defaults to currently visible slide.

docUri.description: Optional: target a specific open .wslide file.

languageModelTools.name: wolfslide_insertSlide
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Insert one slide (at afterIndex; default the end). Blocks: container, heading, text, image, list, math, box, code, arrow, eval, raw; $…$ for KaTeX; fragmentOrder sets the reveal order. For several slides use wolfslide_bulkInsert.

slide.description: Slide object: label (required), background, layout (column|row|grid), gap, padding, children: [{type, content, style, …}].

fit.description: Set false to skip the FIT summary in the response.

languageModelTools.name: wolfslide_replaceSlide
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Rebuild a slide's whole structure in one call, keeping its id. For a few properties use wolfslide_patchBlock; for label, background or layout use wolfslide_editSlide.

slideIndex.description: 1-based slide number to replace (matches wolfslide_listSlides). Omit to target the currently visible slide.

slideId.description: Slide id to replace (alternative to slideIndex).

slide.description: The full replacement slide (label, background, layout, gap, padding, children). Its id is kept unless you set slide.id.

fit.description: Set false to skip the FIT summary in the response.

languageModelTools.name: wolfslide_editSlide
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Change slide-level settings only: label, background, layout, gap, padding, align/justify, scale, transition, notes, hidden. Omit slideIndex for the slide on screen. For blocks use wolfslide_patchBlock.

slideIndex.description: 1-based slide number matching the thumbnail panel (same as the number shown as 'Slide N' in wolfslide_listSlides). Pass 15 to target slide 15.

patch.description: Slide fields: label, background, layout, gap, padding, hidden, transition, notes, align, justify, scale, baseFontSize.

dryRun.description: With a children array: return the block diff (kept, patched, added, deleted) without saving. Required when patching children.

fit.description: Set false to skip the FIT summary in the response.

languageModelTools.name: wolfslide_deleteSlide
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Delete one slide. Old name — use wolfslide_deleteSlides.

slideIndex.description: 1-based slide number matching the thumbnail panel (same as 'Slide N' in wolfslide_listSlides).

languageModelTools.name: wolfslide_deleteSlides
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Delete slides by a list of indices or a from/to range (1-based). At least one slide must remain.

slideIndices.description: Array of 1-based slide indices to delete (e.g. [3, 5, 7]).

from.description: 1-based start of the range to delete (inclusive). Used with 'to'.

to.description: 1-based end of the range to delete (inclusive). Used with 'from'.

docUri.description: URI of the .wslide document. Defaults to the active editor.

languageModelTools.name: wolfslide_moveSlide
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Move a slide to toIndex (its 1-based final position).

slideIndex.description: 1-based slide number matching the thumbnail panel (same as 'Slide N' in wolfslide_listSlides). Required unless using slideId.

toIndex.description: Target 1-based index. Use 1 to move to the first position. Using 0 is treated the same as 1.

languageModelTools.name: wolfslide_undo
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Undo the last deck change made through wolfslide_* tools (20 steps; separate from the editor's own undo).

docUri.description: Optional URI of the .wslide file to undo in. Defaults to the active editor.

languageModelTools.name: wolfslide_reload
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Reload the deck from disk, discarding unsaved tool changes and the undo stack.

docUri.description: Optional URI of the .wslide file to reload. Defaults to the active editor.

languageModelTools.name: wolfslide_saveFile
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Save the deck to disk.

languageModelTools.name: wolfslide_exportHtml
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Export the deck as one standalone Reveal.js HTML file with images inlined.

outputPath.description: Optional output file path. Defaults to <deckName>.html next to the .wslide file.

languageModelTools.name: wolfslide_insertEvalBlock
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Add a Wolfram evaluation block to a slide and run it: plots render as SVG, formulas as KaTeX. kernel_id picks the kernel when the window has several.

parentBlockId.description: Optional parent container block id to insert into.

w.description: Image width in pixels for rasterization. Default: 800.

kernel_id.description: Kernel to evaluate in (from wolfbook_list_clients / wolfbook_status scope:'kernels'). Required only when this window has several live kernels.

languageModelTools.name: wolfslide_runEvalBlock
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Re-run a slide's eval block, optionally with a new input expression.

input.description: Optional new Mathematica expression. If omitted, re-runs the existing input.

kernel_id.description: Kernel to evaluate in (from wolfbook_list_clients / wolfbook_status scope:'kernels'). Required only when this window has several live kernels.

languageModelTools.name: wolfslide_setTheme
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Set the deck theme from a preset (academic-light, dark-modern, dark-navy, solarized-dark, high-contrast, warm-cream) or custom colours, plus deck style presets. Change editorCSS in place with appendEditorCSS or editorCSSReplace.

theme.description: Custom theme object with color keys: navy, blue, cyan, accent, editorCSS. Used when preset is not specified.

defaultBackground.description: Background color to apply to all slides that currently have default backgrounds.

applyBackground.description: Whether to update slide backgrounds to match the preset. Default: true.

stylePresets.description: Deck-level named style objects, e.g. {"section-header": {"color": "#fff"}}; null deletes a preset.

appendEditorCSS.description: Append this CSS snippet to the deck's existing editorCSS — lets you add one rule without resending the whole blob.

editorCSSReplace.description: Literal edits to editorCSS: [{"find","replace"}] or [["find","replace"]]; misses are reported.

languageModelTools.name: wolfslide_bulkInsert
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Insert many slides in one call (block types as in wolfslide_insertSlide). For large batches pass slidesPath, a JSON file: inline payloads over ~10 KB can be truncated in transport.

slides.description: Slide objects as in wolfslide_insertSlide; every block needs a type.

afterIndex.description: Insert after this 1-based index. 0 = prepend. Default: append at end.

theme.description: Theme preset name (string) or custom theme object to apply to the deck.

meta.description: Deck metadata to set, e.g. {title: 'My Talk', author: 'Name'}.

slidesPath.description: JSON file with the slides array (or {slides:[…]}), absolute or relative to the deck. Avoids transport truncation.

fit.description: Set false to skip the per-slide fit check in the response.

languageModelTools.name: wolfbook_getCellOutput
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read one cell's committed output and run state (never-run, running, success, failed, stale …) without re-running it.

cellId.description: Stable CellId of the cell (preferred over cellNumber).

cellNumber.description: 1-based cell number. Use cellId when available.

languageModelTools.name: wolfbook_validateSyntax
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Check Wolfram syntax (SyntaxQ) of one cell or a range; falls back to bracket matching when no kernel is running.

cellId.description: Stable CellId to validate (single cell, preferred over cellNumber after reordering).

cellNumber.description: Check a single cell by 1-based number. Use cellId when available.

endCell.description: Range: last cell to check (inclusive, 1-based). Defaults to last cell.

languageModelTools.name: wolfbook_latex
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Legacy .tex build: save, compile with latexmk, parse the log ("build" does all three). To edit the user's paper prefer the paper_* tools.

action.description: save: write .tex to disk. compile: run latexmk. errors: parse .log for errors. build: save + compile + return errors.

path.description: Path to .tex file (absolute or relative to notebook dir).

content.description: LaTeX source content (required for 'save' and 'build' actions).

content_encoding.description: Legacy; omit. Source is used verbatim.

languageModelTools.name: wolfslide_searchSlides
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Search the deck and get locations (slide, block ID, snippet), not whole slides — by text, regex, block type or style value.

query.description: Text to search for (case-insensitive). Optional when blockType or styleKey is provided.

docUri.description: Optional: target a specific open .wslide file.

styleKey.description: Style property name to filter on (e.g. "color", "fontSize", "background"). Combined with styleValue for exact matching.

styleValue.description: Style property value to match (partial, case-insensitive). Requires styleKey.

regex.description: Treat query as a JavaScript regular expression. Returns the match in context.

searchRaw.description: Search the raw HTML/markup rather than tag-stripped text — needed for hrefs, class names, inline styles.

languageModelTools.name: wolfslide_block
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Block operations: insert, edit (childrenOps for child arrays), delete, move, bulkEdit, getBlock, and bulkPatch by selector across the deck. For a simple property change use wolfslide_patchBlock.

action.description: insert | edit | delete | move | bulkEdit | getBlock | bulkPatch (same patch to every block matching selector).

blockId.description: Target block ID (for edit/delete/move/getBlock). Use blockName as a stable alternative.

blockName.description: Block name (alternative to blockId), searched across all slides.

block.description: Block object to insert (required for 'insert'). Include type, content, and optionally a 'name' field for future addressing.

updates.description: edit: properties to patch (alias patch; null deletes). childrenOps: [{op:"insert",afterId,block},{op:"remove",blockId},{op:"reorder",ids}].

parentBlockId.description: Insert/move into this container block (for insert/move).

docUri.description: Optional: target a specific open .wslide file.

selector.description: bulkPatch filter, all keys ANDed: type, className, namePattern (glob), blockIds, hasStyle {cssKey: value}, stylePreset.

patch.description: bulkPatch: patch for every match (deep merge; null deletes; arrays replace).

languageModelTools.name: wolfslide_patchBlock
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Change a block's properties (deep merge; null deletes a key) by blockId or blockName, or omit patch to read its JSON. If that id or name exists on several slides, pass slideIndex — the tool errors rather than guess.

blockName.description: Block name (set via "name" at creation); more stable than an ID.

patch.description: Properties to merge (deep; null deletes a key; arrays replace). Omit to read the block's JSON.

slideIndex.description: 1-based slide that holds the block. Needed when the id or name exists on several slides — the tool errors rather than guess.

slideId.description: Slide ID to narrow the search (alternative to slideIndex).

docUri.description: Optional: target a specific open .wslide file.

fit.description: Set false to skip the FIT summary in the response.

languageModelTools.name: wolfslide_advanced
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Deck-wide checks and fixes: fitAll (every slide that overflows, with rescale hints), measure (one slide), check (static audit and layout lints), checkRefs (arXiv ids against INSPIRE), promoteStyle, duplicate, reorderFragments.

action.description: fitAll | measure | check | checkRefs | promoteStyle | duplicate | reorderFragments.

order.description: Fragment order array for 'reorderFragments'. Each entry: blockId string or {blockId, step} object.

docUri.description: Optional: target a specific open .wslide file.

raw.description: measure only: return full per-block boxes as JSON instead of the compact report.

from.description: fitAll only: first 1-based slide to check (default 1).

to.description: fitAll only: last 1-based slide to check (default: last slide).

maxRefs.description: checkRefs only: cap on distinct arXiv ids to resolve (default 60).

houseFormat.description: checkRefs only: also emit a house-format citation line per reference.

apply.description: promoteStyle only: actually create the presets and rewrite blocks. Default false (dry run).

minCount.description: promoteStyle only: minimum blocks sharing a style before it is promoted (default 3).

presetName.description: promoteStyle only: name for the promoted preset (numbered when several clusters are found).

languageModelTools.name: wolfslide_arrange
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Align and/or evenly distribute absolutely positioned blocks on a slide (the given blocks, or all of them).

align.description: Align edge/axis: left|right|hcenter align horizontally; top|bottom|vcenter align vertically. Omit to only distribute.

distribute.description: Space the blocks' centres evenly along this axis (needs 3+ blocks). Omit to only align.

relativeTo.description: selection (the blocks' bounding box; default for 2+) | slide (the 1920×1080 canvas).

blockIds.description: Block ids to arrange. If omitted, all absolute-positioned blocks on the slide are used.

slideIndex.description: 1-based slide index. If omitted, resolved from blockIds, else the first slide.

docUri.description: Optional: target a specific open .wslide file.

languageModelTools.name: wolfslide_copySlides
languageModelTools.displayName: Wolfslide: Copy Slides to Another Deck
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Copy slides between two open decks, including their images (paths are rewritten).

sourceDocUri.description: URI of the source .wslide file (as shown in wolfslide_getContext). Defaults to the currently active editor.

targetDocUri.description: URI of the destination .wslide file. Must be open in the editor. Get URIs from wolfslide_getContext.

slideIndices.description: 1-based slide numbers to copy from the source (e.g. [1, 3, 5]). Use this OR from+to.

from.description: 1-based start of a contiguous range to copy (inclusive). Use with 'to'.

to.description: 1-based end of the range to copy (inclusive). Use with 'from'.

insertAtIndex.description: 1-based position in the target deck where the slides should be inserted. Defaults to appending at the end.

languageModelTools.name: wolfslide_imageAsset
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Deck images in img/<deck>.wslide/: list, info, copy in, rename (updates references), delete, annotate, or insert into a slide.

action.description: list | info | copy | delete | rename | annotate | insert.

filename.description: Target filename within the deck's img/ folder (e.g. 'spectrum_plot.png'). Used by: info, delete, rename, annotate, insert.

srcPath.description: Absolute path to the source file on disk. Used by: copy, insert.

annotation.description: String (description) or object {description, source, tags[]} to save as .ann.json sidecar. Used by: copy, insert, annotate.

slideIndex.description: 1-based slide index to insert the image block into. Used by: insert.

slideId.description: Slide id (alternative to slideIndex). Used by: insert.

targetBlockId.description: If provided, the image block is appended as a child of this container block (for insertion into nested layouts). Used by: insert.

w.description: Display width in pixels for the inserted image block. Defaults to image's native width (capped at 1600).

h.description: Display height in pixels for the inserted image block. Defaults to image's native height (capped at 900).

fit.description: Object-fit mode for the inserted image block. Default: 'contain'.

style.description: Optional CSS style object for the inserted image block.

fragmentOrder.description: Animation step for the inserted image block.

overwrite.description: copy: replace an existing file of the same name, so slides keep their src. Default false (adds a timestamp).

force.description: For action:'delete' — delete even if the image is still referenced by slide blocks.

docUri.description: Optional: target a specific open .wslide file.

languageModelTools.name: wolfbook_runCells
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Run a contiguous range of notebook cells sequentially and return their combined output. Use startCell/endCell (1-based cell numbers) to specify the range. Cells are run in order; if stopOnError is true (default), execution stops on the first error. Returns a summary line per cell showing output or error. Prefer this over repeated wolfbook_runCell calls when executing consecutive cells.

startCell.description: 1-based cell number to start from (inclusive). Defaults to 1.

endCell.description: 1-based cell number to end at (inclusive). Defaults to last cell.

stopOnError.description: Stop execution if a cell produces an error. Default true.

timeoutSeconds.description: Global timeout in seconds for the entire range. Default 120.

notebook.description: Notebook filename to target. Defaults to the active open notebook.

caption.description: Short human-readable reminder of what this operation is doing.

wait_mode.description: Return immediately with an operation ID when async; otherwise wait up to timeoutSeconds.

progress_symbol.description: Optional Wolfram symbol to sample during execution.

stop_on_failure.description: Stop only on structured failure; default true.

languageModelTools.name: wolfbook_showImage
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Return a local image (PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP or SVG; ≤ 4 MB) inline so you can look at a plot or export.

path.description: Absolute path to the image file to display.

languageModelTools.name: paper_getOutline
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Orientation for a LaTeX paper: counts, warnings and top-level headings; mode=tree for deeper headings, mode=objects for a paginated object inventory; include_project adds the file graph. Read-only.

file.description: Path to the .tex file. Absolute, workspace-relative, or a bare basename. Omit to use the active/only open .tex.

include_project.description: Also resolve the root file and walk the \\input/\\include graph.

mode.description: summary (default), nested heading tree, or paginated semantic objects.

include_identity.description: Include objectId and stableKey on outline nodes; off by default.

selector.description: Restrict the outline/inventory to one section by label, stableKey, or title substring.

from_line.description: Restrict headings/objects to this 1-based line or later.

to_line.description: Restrict headings/objects to this 1-based line or earlier.

languageModelTools.name: paper_getObject
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Fetch one equation, figure, table, paragraph, section or theorem by \label, stableKey or objectId, with its source, lines and sourceHash (pass that to paper_applyEdit). Read-only. Source is verbatim. If textTruncated is true, fetch again with a larger max_chars before constructing a whole-object replacement; sourceHash always covers the entire object. selectors fetches up to 10 objects in one bounded snapshot.

file.description: Path to the .tex file. Absolute, workspace-relative, or a bare basename. Omit to use the active/only open .tex.

selector.description: A \\label (e.g. eq:dispersion), a stableKey, or an objectId.

include_neighbours.description: Also return the preceding and following objects.

max_chars.description: Source characters: default 4000 for one object; total budget 8000 for a batch (maximum 32000).

reveal.description: Open the file and reveal/select this object in the editor.

selectors.description: Read 1–10 objects from one document snapshot. Cannot combine with selector or reveal. max_chars caps total batch source.

languageModelTools.name: paper_getSection
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Fetch a section (by label, stableKey or title substring) and every addressable object in it. Read-only. The section identity/hash addresses the heading only; included text covers heading and body. Use a batch of contained-object edits for body changes, or append_to_section.

file.description: Path to the .tex file. Absolute, workspace-relative, or a bare basename. Omit to use the active/only open .tex.

selector.description: Heading label, stableKey, or part of its title.

languageModelTools.name: paper_findReferences
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Cross-reference health. With name: where that label is defined and everything citing it. Without: all unresolved, duplicate and unused labels. Read-only.

file.description: Path to the .tex file. Absolute, workspace-relative, or a bare basename. Omit to use the active/only open .tex.

name.description: A label or citation key. Omit for a whole-file report.

include_project.description: Resolve the root and audit declarations/references across the complete include graph.

languageModelTools.name: paper_search
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Search objects in the user's LaTeX paper by text, regex or label prefix (several queries in one call), filtered by kind, section or line range. For published literature use wolfbook_literatureSearch. Read-only.

file.description: Path to the .tex file. Absolute, workspace-relative, or a bare basename. Omit to use the active/only open .tex.

query.description: Text to find, or a regular expression when regex is true.

regex.description: Treat query as a case-insensitive regular expression.

kinds.description: Restrict to these object kinds, e.g. display-equation, figure, paragraph.

within_section.description: Restrict matches to section paths containing this text.

from_line.description: Restrict matches to objects starting at or after this 1-based line.

to_line.description: Restrict matches to objects starting at or before this 1-based line.

limit_per_query.description: Maximum matches for each batched query.

max_depth.description: Maximum section-path depth of returned objects.

queries.description: Several searches evaluated in one parse/index pass.

include_project.description: Search all files in the resolved LaTeX include graph, using open unsaved buffers when present.

languageModelTools.name: paper_mathematicaBlocks
languageModelTools.modelDescription: List the %Mathematica blocks in a .tex file and whether each is fresh, stale, modified, orphaned or malformed. Read-only; running blocks is not available yet.

file.description: Path to the .tex file. Absolute, workspace-relative, or a bare basename. Omit to use the active/only open .tex.

languageModelTools.name: paper_previewEdit
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Preview a paper edit or an atomic batch (replace, insert, append_to_section, delete, move, wrap, rename_label) without writing: a diff, reference changes and a transaction_id for paper_applyEdit.

file.description: Path to the .tex file. Absolute, workspace-relative, or a bare basename. Omit to use the active/only open .tex.

new_text.description: Replacement source for the whole object, including its \\begin/\\end.

expected_source_hash.description: Reject unless the object's current source SHA-256 matches.

expected_source_prefix.description: Reject unless the current source starts with this.

expected_document_hash.description: Reject unless the complete current document has this SHA-256.

edits.description: Atomic semantic edits. All are previewed together or the transaction is rejected.

verify.description: Verification defaults saved with the preview transaction.

projection.description: MCP receipt projection, default compact with full details handle. full returns all original details.

languageModelTools.name: paper_listenComments
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Listen on one .tex file: start, next, context, ack, release, status, stop. Compact deliveries carry guarded source spans and context handles. Context batches accept comment_ids. Apply verify:true before ack; only unchanged comments are consumed. Reader edits take priority. start returns client wake-up setup; waiting does not wake an inactive agent. status recovers outstanding delivery identity.

action.description: Default start. next waits/delivers; ack consumes only after a verified edit; release preserves for retry; stop removes the listener.

file.description: Exact .tex path, required for start; otherwise listener_id identifies the file.

include_existing.description: Start with already posted comments too (default false). Set true to recover pending comments after a restart.

wait_seconds.description: next wait duration, default 45. Above 45 requires a client with long request waits, or the returned asynchronous operation handle; waiting alone cannot wake an inactive model.

delivery_id.description: Delivery returned by next, required for ack/release.

operation_id.description: Successful paper_applyEdit receipt made after delivery with LaTeX verification; required for ack.

agent.description: Client for native wake-up instructions. Default auto detects MCP client name; set explicitly for language-model clients without that metadata. The model installs its own native scheduler; Wolfbook never launches another conversation.

comment_id.description: Delivered comment to read with action:context.

projection.description: Default compact guards and identities. full includes quotes, object source, context and metadata; status full includes wake-up instructions.

comment_ids.description: Batch context for these delivered comments. limit is the total quoted source budget.

languageModelTools.name: paper_applyEdit
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Apply guarded semantic edits or exact text patches as one undoable edit. Comment patches use delivery_id and expected_span_hash, bypassing object lookup. verify:true compiles privately; acknowledge:true consumes only verified unchanged patched comments. Mini-editor overlaps return user-editing. save:true saves only verified edits. Response waits up to 10 seconds by default; longer work returns an operation handle.

file.description: Path to the .tex file. Absolute, workspace-relative, or a bare basename. Omit to use the active/only open .tex.

new_text.description: Replacement source for the whole object, including its \\begin/\\end.

expected_source_hash.description: Reject unless the object's current source SHA-256 matches. Strongly recommended.

expected_source_prefix.description: Reject unless the current source starts with this.

transaction_id.description: Transaction returned by paper_previewEdit. Preferred for atomic apply.

action.description: Default apply; history returns recent semantic receipts; undo requires undo_token.

undo_token.description: Guarded undo token returned by a prior successful apply.

expected_document_hash.description: Reject a direct transaction unless the complete document has this SHA-256.

edits.description: Direct atomic semantic edits; previewing first and applying transaction_id is safer.

verify.description: true parses, audits references and compiles with rollback on failure. An object selects checks (parse/references and rollback default on; latex is opt-in); false explicitly disables verification. Saving requires successful verification.

delivery_id.description: Active comment delivery constraining patches to its exact quoted spans; file may be inferred.

patches.description: Guarded text replacements. With delivery_id, hash the delivered editable_span; otherwise hash expected_old_text and require a unique match in current source. Verification defaults to true.

comment_id.description: Select the delivered comment when several spans match.

expected_span_hash.description: SHA-256 of the delivered span, or expected_old_text without a delivery.

acknowledge.description: Consume only patched comments after successful LaTeX verification; returns a separate acknowledgment outcome.

wait_seconds.description: MCP inline response wait, default 10 seconds; longer operations retain asynchronous handles.

projection.description: MCP receipt projection, default compact with full details handle. full returns all original details.
